the mechanical properties of synthetic polyelectrolysate multilayers can be tuned independently from their ligand presentation.

The main takeaway from our work is that

synthetic materials with tunable mechanical properties can be used to modulate cellular processes, such as hepatocyte functions, in a way that is not possible with conventional tissue culture materials, such as tissue-culture polysterene.
